visual_elements.description: Small parameter table with 3 rows and 2 columns. Row 1: step | 0.2. Row 2: initial X | 3. Row 3: delta | 0.1. Left label cells are green-tinted; right value cells are white.

Cartesian grid, approximately x from -5 to 15 and y from -5 to 15, with tick labels -5, 0, 5, 10, 15. Blue parabola for f(x)=(x-5)^2+1. Red dashed vertical line at x=5. Green point at (5,1). Black line segment from labeled point (2,10) to labeled point (7,1). Red point at (2,10); another unlabeled red point is visible near the right intersection of the black line with the parabola. Labels: (2,10), (7,1), (5,1).
Centered formula block with magenta/pink border. Contains f(x)=(x-5)^2+1 in large black text, X = 5 in red, and f(x) Minimum value is 1.0 with 1.0 in blue.
Callout text Reach Minimum after 11 Steps in purple with a magenta/pink underline.
Solid red block arrow pointing downward from the small parameter table area toward the large iteration table.

imagery: White mouse cursor arrow with black outline near the center-left of the formula area.
typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout. Title is bold and large with mixed red and green segments. Formula text is larger than body text. Table text is compact and mostly black; key values and labels are color-coded. No bullet glyphs are used.
animation_state: No obvious mid-build; all elements appear fully revealed.
